basic_details.job_title: ILBS Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Senior Project Associate, Project Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Institute of Liver & Biliary Sciences (ILBS), an autonomous society under the Government of NCT of Delhi, is filling one Senior Project Associate post (Rs. 57,000 + 30% HRA, total Rs. 74,100 per month) and one Project Assistant post (Rs. 27,000 + 30% HRA, total Rs. 35,100 per month) on contract in a 3-year project funded by the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF). Applicants must email the filled application form and resume to [email protected] with the subject "ANRF ARG-2026" by 10 December 2026. Shortlisted candidates are called for an interview/skill test on Tuesday 15 Decemb

qualification.details: Bachelor's Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences / Master's Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences / BVSc / BPharm / Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Technology or Medicine from a recognised University or equivalent, with four years' experience in R&D in industrial and academic institutions or S&T organisations, and scientific activities and services. OR Master's Degree in Engineering or Technology from a recognised University or equivalent, with two years' experience in R&D in industrial and academic institutions or S&T organisations, and scientific activities and services. OR Doctoral Degree in Science / Engineering / Technology / Pharma / MD / Master of Surgery from a recognised University or equivalent. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

how_to_apply: Fill in the application form printed in the notice (the form is headed "Application for the post of ____").
Email the duly filled application form and resume to [email protected].
Write the subject of the email as "ANRF ARG-2026".

The form asks for name in block letters, gender, marital status, permanent and postal address, date of birth (with documentary evidence), citizenship details, category (UR / SC / ST / OBC / Ex Service men, with documentary evidence; PWD with 40% or more disability), father's/husband's name, educational qualifications from matriculation onwards, work experience, two references and a signed declaration. It has space for a recent passport size photograph.
important_instructions: The subject line of the email must be "ANRF ARG-2026". The appointment is on contract for 12 months initially; extension depends on performance. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview. The declaration in the form states that if any information is found false or incorrect, or ineligibility is detected before or after the test, interview and joining, the candidature will stand cancelled and all claims of the recruitment will be forfeited. For queries, call the Department of Molecular and Cellular Medicine on 011-46300000 Ext: 24165.

Senior Project Associate: Rs. 57,000 + 30% HRA, total Rs. 74,100 pm; Project Assistant: Rs. 27,000 + 30% HRA, total Rs. 35,100 pm
Institute of Liver & Biliary Sciences, New Delhi

content_sections.heading: About ILBS
content_sections.text: The Institute of Liver & Biliary Sciences is an autonomous society under the Government of NCT of Delhi, located at D-1, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi - 110070. This notice covers posts in a project funded by ANRF, titled "Agentic AI for fast and accurate Diagnosis of Minimal Hepatic Encephalopathy (MHE) in Cirrhotic patients". The notice's query contact is the Department of Molecular and Cellular Medicine.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 2 openings in total, one in each post.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice does not print an age cut-off date or any age relaxation. Bachelor's Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences / Master's Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences / BVSc / BPharm / Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Technology or Medicine from a recognised University or equivalent, with four years' experience in R&D in industrial and academic institutions or S&T organisations, and scientific activities and services. OR Master's Degree in Engineering or Technology from a recognised University or equivalent, with two years' experience in R&D in industrial and academic institutions or S&T organisations, and scientific activities and services. OR Doctoral Degree in Science / Engineering / Technology / Pharma / MD / Master of Surgery from a recognised University or equivalent. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: One of three routes, listed below the table
rows.desirable: Experience in Artificial intelligence (AI) in healthcare and/or Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) modality

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor's degree in science / 3 years Diploma in Engineering & Technology
rows.desirable: Experience in data collection, clinical trial, data analysis (Excel/SPSS)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Senior Project Associate is paid Rs. 57,000 plus 30% HRA, a total of Rs. 74,100 per month. The Project Assistant is paid Rs. 27,000 plus 30% HRA, a total of Rs. 35,100 per month. The project runs for 3 years. The appointment is on a "contract basis" for 12 months initially and will be extended on the basis of performance. No TA/DA will be provided.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ILBS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form printed in the notice (the form is headed "Application for the post of ____"). Prepare a resume. Email the duly filled application form and resume to [email protected] . Write the subject of the email as "ANRF ARG-2026". Send the email by 10 December 2026. The form asks for name in block letters, gender, marital status, permanent and postal address, date of birth (with documentary evidence), citizenship details, category (UR / SC / ST / OBC / Ex Service men, with documentary evidence; PWD with 40% or more disability), father's/husband's name, educational qualifications from matriculation onwards, work experience, two references and a signed declaration. It has space for a recent passport size photograph.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview/skill test, to be held at the Institute on Tuesday 15 December 2026. The notice does not describe the shortlisting method or the venue within the Institute. Shortlisted candidates must bring photocopies of all degree/certificate/diploma/testimonials along with their printed application form.

The declaration in the form states that if any information is found false or incorrect, or ineligibility is detected before or after the test, interview and joining, the candidature will stand cancelled and all claims of the recruitment will be forfeited. For queries, call the Department of Molecular and Cellular Medicine on 011-46300000 Ext: 24165.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ILBS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: one Senior Project Associate and one Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the ILBS project posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be emailed by 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the ILBS Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The Project Assistant needs a Bachelor's degree in science or a 3 years Diploma in Engineering & Technology. Experience in data collection, clinical trial and data analysis (Excel/SPSS) is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for ILBS Senior Project Associate and Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The age limit is 45 years for the Senior Project Associate and 35 years for the Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the ILBS Senior Project Associate?
faq.answer: The Senior Project Associate gets Rs. 57,000 plus 30% HRA, a total of Rs. 74,100 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the salary at ILBS?
faq.answer: The notice shows each pay as a basic amount plus 30% HRA with a stated total: Rs. 57,000 + 30% HRA = Rs. 74,100 pm for the Senior Project Associate, and Rs. 27,000 + 30% HRA = Rs. 35,100 pm for the Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for ILBS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Email the duly filled application form and resume to [email protected] with the subject "ANRF ARG-2026" by 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected for the ILBS project posts?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates are called for an interview/skill test at the Institute on Tuesday 15 December 2026. They must bring photocopies of their degree, certificate, diploma and testimonials along with the printed application form.

faq.question: Q9. Are the ILBS project posts permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is on contract basis for 12 months initially and will be extended on the basis of performance, within a project of 3 years.

faq.question: Q10. Will ILBS pay travel allowance for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be provided.
